2120855841100189933.en_summary: $NVDA investors rush to buy Nvidia dip despite CEO crisis. Nearly 90% of Nvidia trades by Saxo clients from Monday to Wednesday were buys, signaling aggressive dip-buying. Nvidia was traded 12 times more than any other stock on the platform. Yet shares fell another 8.4% premarket Thursday as the board weighed Jensen Huang's future. Saxo warns investors may be underestimating succession risk, with no obvious replacement for Huang.
2120855841100189933.zh_summary: $NVDA 投資者急於買入 Nvidia 的回調，儘管有 CEO 危機。Saxo 客戶週一至週三近 90% 的 Nvidia 交易是買入，顯示積極的回調買入。Nvidia 在平台上的交易量是其他股票的 12 倍。然而，週四盤前股價再跌 8.4%，因董事會權衡 Jensen Huang 的未來。Saxo 警告投資者可能低估了繼任風險，沒有明顯的 Huang 替代者。

2120855683549778124.en_summary: Melius: We thought we had experience, but nothing prepares you for what has happened at $NVDA over the last few weeks. The only situation remotely close was HP. Waiting to see what that Board would do (and who they would hire) that time didn't work out.
2120855683549778124.zh_summary: Melius：我們以為有經驗，但沒有什麼能讓你為過去幾週 $NVDA 發生的事情做好準備。唯一接近的情況是 HP。等待看那個董事會會做什麼（以及他們會聘請誰），那次並沒有成功。
